texts: good. both trigger clauses become plain rule premises, so the rule fires, and the failure is minted once per distillation run and tied to that run, with every participant covered.

mixed: the rule fires, but its output is keyed to the cauldron instead of to the boiling, so repeated hard boils of one cauldron collapse onto a single yield event and a single slick — two separate boils would wrongly share one slick. Make the boiling itself the yielder and leave the cauldron as the place, which keeps every participant: "Whenever a cauldron boils hard, that boiling yields a thin slick of poor essence in the cauldron." The "of poor essence" phrasing itself is fine — the slick simply comes out typed as thin, poor essence.
